svg.title: The HAYDNsim pipeline, in six stages
svg.desc: Archive data from Gaia DR3, HST and four catalogues; a bright-star threshold and membership selection; a King profile normalised to HST; a TRILEGAL population placed by inverse-CDF sampling; the HAYDN Noise Estimator run on Deucalion, which returns a noise-to-signal ratio and a stellar pollution ratio per star; and a seismic performance model. Open clusters and resolved fields skip the profile and population steps.
